name: Box Breathing
instructions: Repeat the cycle 4-6 times, keeping a steady even rhythm.

name: 4-7-8 Breathing
instructions: Repeat 3-4 cycles; exhale should feel long and audible.

name: Diaphragmatic Breathing
pattern: Inhale slowly through the nose, feel the belly rise, not the chest
instructions: Place one hand on the belly, one on the chest; only the belly hand should move.

name: Coherent Breathing
instructions: Continue for 3-5 minutes, keeping breaths smooth and unforced.

name: Extended Exhale
instructions: Repeat for 1-2 minutes; a longer exhale activates the calming nervous system response.

name: Sighing Breath
pattern: Take a full inhale, then a second short top-up inhale, then release a long slow exhale (like a sigh)
instructions: Repeat 3 times; helpful for immediate tension release.

name: Alternate Nostril (simplified)
pattern: Inhale through one nostril (gently close the other with a finger), exhale through the other side
instructions: Alternate sides for 5-6 rounds; slow and unhurried.

name: Counted Breath
pattern: Simply count each inhale and exhale up to 10, then restart from 1
instructions: Use when the mind needs a simple anchor rather than a pattern.

name: Pursed Lip Breathing
pattern: Inhale through the nose for 2s, exhale slowly through pursed lips for 4s
instructions: Good for slowing a fast breathing rate during anxiety.

name: Humming Breath (Bhramari-inspired)
pattern: Inhale normally, exhale while making a soft humming sound
instructions: Repeat 5-6 times; the vibration can have a calming effect.
